detail:
Decisions: Chose to make reason_rejected optional and omit it entirely rather than keep a placeholder — the empirical panel measured 217 of 217 NL-derived alternatives carrying the literal string 'Not chosen', a tautology in the field that should hold the why-not; an honest absence is strictly better than a fabricated reason, and JSON.stringify drops the undefined key so no record asserts a reason it lacks; Chose to keep the structured zod schema's reason_rejected REQUIRED while making the stored type optional — all 185 structured reasons in the corpus are real authored text, so that gate demonstrably works and loosening it would invite the same laundering through the path that is currently healthy; Chose to implement only what BOTH judges agreed on and to SKIP approach A's shape-veto battery (adverb-lead, bare-participle, length, single-letter) and anchored-over allowlist — the second judge measured those as pure recall loss biased against gerund-led options, which are the dominant form of a rejected action, and the first judge itself asked for re-ablation before shipping them; Chose to delete the bare /not/ rejection pattern outright rather than replace it with the narrower appositive form — a candidate built and measured the ,\s+not variant and found it WORSE on real data (13 of 15 added options were rhetorical prose contrast), so the honest move is deletion plus a test pinning the accepted miss; Chose to let only the labelled form ('Alternative rejected: X — reason') populate reason_rejected — it is the sole construction in prose that states a real why-not, measured at 0% error, whereas unordered contrast keywords name an option without ever stating why it lost; Chose to stamp rationale_source at BOTH record-parser.ts and record-tools.ts buildFromStructured rather than the parser alone — ground truth showed the structured builder owns 12 of the 16 laundered records, so a parser-only fix would have missed 75% of the defect
Findings: Empirical panel ground truth on 417 real decisions: 275 have alternatives (402 entries). 181 records / 217 entries are NL-path, ALL carrying 'Not chosen'; 94 records / 185 entries are structured, every reason distinct and real. 'Not chosen' is the only reason_rejected value in the entire corpus that repeats — a zero-false-positive path discriminator. Option LENGTH is not a detector (placeholder p50=32 vs structured p50=44), confirming my earlier over-count correction.; Of the 217 placeholder options, hand-labelling found 153 SENSIBLE (70.5%), 60 NONSENSE (27.6%), 4 DEGENERATE. So extraction is mostly right — the dominant defect was never bad option names but the fabricated reason attached to all 217.; The NL path is RECENT and worsening, not legacy sediment: 2026-02 and 2026-03 are 100% structured; NL-path records begin 2026-04 and 158 of the 181 land in 2026-07.; Semantic inversion was the worst failure class, now fixed: 'Chose NOT to reorder the ladder to prefer the bundled server over npx' stored 'npx' as the REJECTED option when npx is what was KEPT. A negated-choice veto suppresses unordered extraction inside chose/decided/opted-not-to clauses while leaving labelled forms intact.; need: the one-shot data migration over the 181 legacy records (strip 'Not chosen', stamp provenance) is NOT done and was deliberately deferred by both judges — it writes to a live decision store and belongs in its own change. Until it runs, legacy records keep rendering the tautology in assembled context.; warning: plugin/BEHAVIORS.md DECIDE-02 still asserts every alternative must carry a reason_rejected. After this change that is only enforceable on the structured path, so the doc and the code now disagree — needs updating before the next plugin release.
summary: Fixed the NL decision parser: no more fabricated reasons, two unsalvageable patterns deleted, provenance stamped at both laundering sites
